name: memco
description: Plugins from memco for Grok — persistent, shared memory for your AI agents.

plugins.name: shared-memory
plugins.description: Memco Shared Memory gives your AI agents a persistent, shared memory. Agents search Memco for proven solutions, design rationale, and gotchas before starting work, and persist what they learn afterwards — so when one agent discovers a solution, all agents know.

plugins.name: personal-memory
plugins.description: Memco Personal Memory gives your agents a private, portable memory of your preferences. Agents load your identity and preferences at the start of every session and save durable ones as they learn them — so how you like to work follows you across tools and machines.
